title: Our philosophy
body:
We believe the pieces you reach for every day should feel effortless. Simple shapes, calm colors and considered proportions are the starting point for everything we design.

From a compact shoulder bag to a roomy tote, each silhouette has a place in the rhythm of a day. Our philosophy is to keep the essentials in focus and let the details speak quietly.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
body:
Straightforward answers regarding sizing, leather care, and shipping.

Will my phone fit inside the bag?

Yes. The bag easily accommodates all modern smartphones up to the iPhone 15 Pro Max and Samsung Galaxy Ultra series, even when enclosed in a protective case, alongside a bifold wallet and keys.

Is the leather water resistant?

Our full-grain leather is naturally resilient to light humidity and brief rainfall. If caught in rain, simply blot gently with a dry cotton cloth and allow it to air-dry at room temperature away from heat sources.

How long does shipping take?

Orders are dispatched from our studio warehouse within 24 hours on business days. Standard delivery within the US takes 2–4 business days. Complimentary tracking is emailed upon fulfillment.

What is your return policy?

We offer a 30-day trial period. If the bag does not suit your everyday needs, return it in original, unworn condition with its dust bag for a full refund. A prepaid return shipping label is provided.

Can the shoulder strap length be adjusted?

The strap has a fixed 28 cm drop proportioned specifically to tuck securely under the arm and stay positioned on the shoulder without sliding off your coat.
